_doc: Hand-reviewed join from a recipe-used USDA fdcId to a USDA Flavonoid Database R3.3 NDB number, for foods the automatic joins in scripts/build-polyphenols.mjs (own NDB number, a Foundation record's superseded SR number, identical description) miss. Each pair is the same food in the same state; a different cultivar of the same fruit or vegetable is accepted (grape vs cherry tomato, Medjool vs Deglet Noor dates), a different state is not (peeled vs with peel, paste vs fresh, cooked vs raw), and no value is scaled or estimated.
